payload.content: Keep a full paper towel roll upright and steady on the kitchen counter with this 6.5-inch freestanding paper towel holder, built from solid brass with a weighted base for stable one-handed tearing. The Carolina Collection design blends traditional style with contemporary design elements for a classic look that still feels clean and practical. {FINISH_SENTENCE} The space-saving vertical stand helps free up counter space, while a felt pad under the base helps prevent scratching on your surfaces. Solid brass construction and the designer finish are made for corrosion-free and rust-free performance in everyday use. No assembly is required, and the included paper towel holder is ready to place wherever you need it—an easy alternative if you’ve been considering an under cabinet paper towel holder but don’t want to drill or mount hardware. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.
